mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (type, status, remark, create_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{type}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.create_time AS createTime, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.create_time, NOW()) AS waitingSeconds, u.id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.phone AS userPhone, u.avatar AS userAvatar, (SELECT content FROM conversation_message WHERE conversation_id = c.id AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY send_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_message WHERE conversation_id = c.id AND is_deleted = 0) AS messageCount FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN conversation_participant cp ON c.id = cp.conversation_id AND cp.participant_type = 0 AND cp.role = 0 AND cp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_info u ON cp.participant_id = u.id WHERE c.type = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_participant cp2 WHERE cp2.conversation_id = c.id AND cp2.participant_type = 1 AND cp2.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY c.create_time ASC

SELECT c.id, c.type, c.status, c.create_time AS createTime, c.end_time AS endTime, c.remark, u.id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.phone AS userPhone, u.avatar AS userAvatar, a.id AS adminId, a.name AS adminName FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN conversation_participant cp_user ON c.id = cp_user.conversation_id AND cp_user.participant_type = 0 AND cp_user.role = 0 AND cp_user.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_info u ON cp_user.participant_id = u.id LEFT JOIN conversation_participant cp_admin ON c.id = cp_admin.conversation_id AND cp_admin.participant_type = 1 AND cp_admin.role = 1 AND cp_admin.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON cp_admin.participant_id = a.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.is_deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.type, c.status, CASE c.status WHEN 0 THEN '待接入' WHEN 1 THEN '进行中' WHEN 2 THEN '已完成' WHEN 3 THEN '已关闭' END AS statusName, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime, c.end_time AS endTime, cp.unread_count AS unreadCount,
-- 用户信息（从 user_info 表关联） u.id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.username AS userPhone, u.avatar AS userAvatar,
-- 客服/管理员信息 a.id AS adminId, a.name AS adminName,
-- 最后一条消息 (SELECT cm.content FROM conversation_message cm WHERE cm.conversation_id = c.id AND cm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY cm.send_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT cm.send_time FROM conversation_message cm WHERE cm.conversation_id = c.id AND cm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY cm.send_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessageTime,
-- 消息数量 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_message cm WHERE cm.conversation_id = c.id AND cm.is_deleted = 0) AS messageCount
FROM conversation c
-- 当前管理员的参与记录 INNER JOIN conversation_participant cp ON c.id = cp.conversation_id AND cp.participant_id = #{adminId} AND cp.participant_type = 1 AND cp.is_deleted = 0
-- 关联用户参与者，获取用户信息 LEFT JOIN conversation_participant cp_user ON c.id = cp_user.conversation_id AND cp_user.participant_type = 0 AND cp_user.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_info u ON cp_user.participant_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0
-- 关联管理员表，获取客服信息（可选，取第一个管理员参与者） LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON cp.participant_id = a.id AND a.is_deleted = 0
WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
AND c.status = #{status}
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC
